title: An INTEREST REFUND on a not-charged-off loan debits principal to LOAN_PORTFOLIO 7 (loan 15 L87: credit 1.46, debit 1.46)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry an INTEREST_REFUND posted on loan 15 (product LP2_ADV_PMT_ALLOC_ACTUAL_ACTUAL_PROGRESSIVE_LOAN_SCHEDULE_HORIZONTAL, NOT charged off) on the Tier-D MNT replay (throwaway tenant `tierd`, currency MNT, 2 minor digits). The dispatch posts an interest refund through the SAME method as an interest-payment waiver (AccrualBasedAccountingProcessorForLoan.java:134-135, isInterestPaymentWaiver() || isInterestRefund()), and the seam request carries the portions, the charged-off flag and the slot->account mapping only. request.interest_payment_waiver_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back transaction id 87 (externalId L87, type loanTransactionType.interestRefund): principalPortion 1.46 -> "146", interest/fee/penalty/overpayment 0. The charged-off state is the read-back's top-level chargedOff false. accounts is the product's slot->GL-account-id mapping from the accepted create request create-request-LP2_ADV_PMT_ALLOC_ACTUAL_ACTUAL_PROGRESSIVE_LOAN_SCHEDULE_HORIZONTAL.json (sha256 d55b8ed2...ad20): loanPortfolio 7, receivable interest/fee/penalty 4, overpayment 16, interestOnLoan 9, incomeFromChargeOffInterest 17. expect.interest_payment_waiver_journal_legs transcribes the two L87 legs in id order from the sweep: JE 229 CREDIT account 7 1.46, JE 230 DEBIT account 9 1.46. THIS VECTOR GRADES: the principal credit slot on a not-charged-off loan, whose credit account (loan portfolio 7) is NOT the credit account of the interest slot. Nothing was computed: every portion, account and leg is read directly from the committed files; amounts are exact decimals parsed to integer minor units, never a float.
